Ram Rahim Returns to Sunaria Jail After Parole Period Ends

Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh has returned to Sunaria Jail in Rohtak, Haryana, after completing a 30-day parole period. He was accompanied by Honeypreet upon his return to the correctional facility. This marks the end of his temporary release from prison.
